answers.reason: The senate decides on university-wide matters and research staff are not mentioned as participants.
Budget planning rounds allocate funds and are handled by leadership and administration, not research staff.
Appointment committees select candidates for professorships and research staff do not sit in them.
Faculty councils decide on faculty affairs and research staff are not specified as members of these bodies.
Examination boards decide on examination matters and research staff are not included in this group's designated bodies.
